data.explanation: The tax office (Finanzamt) has finished reviewing your 2025 income tax return and set your tax at €4,311.00. Since €5,026.00 in wage tax was already withheld, you are owed a refund of €715.00, which they say they will transfer to your account. If you disagree with the assessment (for example about the rejected home-office room deduction), you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app will show the deadline for this once it computes it from the notification date. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final after that deadline.
